revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~0.8%; modest acceleration to ~3% on pricing plus volume growth, in line with long-run nominal GDP.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 40.2% (9,846/24,510), up from 37.7% in FY2023; hold ~40.5% with modest efficiency gains.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~22.1% = 1-(7,138/9,166) from 10-K acc. 0000100885-26-000037; statutory federal 21% plus state.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 capex 14.9%, 14.2%, 15.5% of revenue; use ~15%.

wacc.source: Computed: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.92 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran Transportation unlevered cash-corrected beta 0.7115 relevered at Damodaran D/E 0.364, tax 21%) = CoE ~8.95%; pre-tax Kd 5.07% (Damodaran) -> 4.0% after tax; weights 73/27 (Damodaran industry, no share price available). WACC ~7.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation/GDP-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 31,814 (LTD noncurrent 30,294 + current 1,520, CP 0) - cash 1,266; 10-K acc. 0000100885-26-000037

diluted_shares.source: Weighted avg diluted shares 595,900,000 = 595.9 millions, 10-K acc. 0000100885-26-000037
